seoTitle: Bot Firewall Rule Builder: Cloudflare, Nginx, Apache
metaDescription: Generate Cloudflare WAF, Nginx and Apache rules that block or rate-limit chosen bots by user-agent. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: Builds user-agent block or rate-limit rules for three platforms from a list of bot names.
why:
robots.txt is a request; a firewall rule is enforcement. For crawlers that ignore robots.txt, you can refuse them at the server.

List the bot tokens and get a Cloudflare custom rule expression, an Nginx map with a 403 or a limit_req setup, and an Apache rewrite rule. User-agent rules only catch bots that identify themselves honestly, and they also block real visitors who carry the word in their string. Test with curl -A.
howTo: List bot tokens, one per line.
Choose block or rate limit and the platform.
Copy the rules into your config.

faq.q: Will this stop a determined scraper?
faq.a: No. It changes its user-agent. Use IP ranges, rate limits or a bot management service.
Not built in; the tool says so in the output.
